notes.title: Version 1.8 Now Available
notes.notes:
As I had mentioned in the preview, this patch is a big roundup of fixes and smoothing out some parts of the game. Hit Contracts will help ease the pain of hitmen and can be purchased in the Slums. There are also a number of new merchants and a wide array of bug fixes.

It may be the last major update for a while, but I'll post an announcement on that later. For now, take a look at the full patch notes below!

[b][u]New Features:[/u][/b]
- New purchasable item: Hit Contract
- Hit Contracts stop any current hitmen that are after the player
- Hit Contracts also greatly reduce the chance of seeing another hitman for a while
[b][u]Gameplay Changes:[/u][/b]
- New vendor added to the Slums that sells Hit Contracts
- New vendor added to the Department Store that sells food
- New vendor added to the Mechanic Shop that sells lockpicks
- All locations now have vendors and/or unique elements that are worth visiting for
[b][u]Fixes and Improvements:[/u][/b]
- Wiping out the entire town will prevent events that couldn't occur without people
- As intended for Sandbox mode, you cannot gain progress for incremental badges
- Previously Sandbox mode only prevented earning "one-time" badges
- Job-related issues such as blank jobs and nameless NPCs have been fixed
- Minor AI improvements
- Various bug fixes

notes.title: Version 1.7 Now Available
notes.notes:
Version 1.7 is now available for all users! As I had mentioned in the preview, this update brings a fair amount of new content with some nifty gameplay changes as well. The Post Office is an ideal non-violent alternative to the Hunt Club, and now both areas are considered "jobs". To go with the new job statistics are the first costumes that can be unlocked without collecting costume scraps. 

For players looking to complete Impossible mode and get the highest scores, challenge points have become even more critical. Now, every challenge point gives 2 starting hunger in addition to the old effects. To encourage players to try harder modes, solving a case on Hard awards 1 challenge point while solving a case on Impossible awards 2 challenge points. Coupled with the Hard/Impossible bonuses for completing challenges, you could earn up to 5 points in one game!

There's plenty more to check out, so take a look at the full patch notes below.

[b][u]New Features:[/u][/b]
- New location added: Post Office
- New item added: Postal Receipt
- Players who find the postal receipt can take package delivery jobs at the Post Office
- Delivering packages to people rewards money, a non-violent alternative to the Hunt Club
- 2 new costumes added (unlocked by completing jobs, not collecting costume scraps)
- Every 1 challenge point earned now also increases starting hunger by 2
[b][u]Gameplay Changes:[/u][/b]
- Closing a case on hard mode awards 1 additional challenge point
- Closing a case on impossible mode awards 2 additional challenge points
- Hitmen show up very rarely on normal mode, sometimes not at all
- Hitmen fire their first bullet slower then before to give the player more time to react
- Hostile NPCs will delay their first attack slightly to allow the player to make better decisions
[b][u]Fixes and Improvements:[/u][/b]
- Added small floating icons over the player when investigate or shoot is pressed
- Added "Jobs Completed" and "Job Cash Earned" to the Statistics screen
- Changed "Clue" to "Item" in the Notebook as job items are also in the list
- NPCs now properly calm down after a while in Sandbox Dinner Party mode
- Players can no longer starve to death in the tutorial
- Minor AI improvements
- Minor bug fixes

notes.title: Version 1.6 Now Available
notes.notes:
Noir Syndrome Version 1.6 is now available for all users!

As I had mentioned in the preview, this patch is on the larger side. An all new "Sandbox" mode has been added that provides unlimited days and hunger. Additionally, the killer has taken to hiring hitmen to stop you from eventually capturing them. As you get closer to solving a case, hired hitmen will try to track you down and try to stop you. Anyone could be out for you, so pay attention to what people say and you might get an early warning that you're being hunted.

If you missed the patch notes, take a look below to see what's new!

[b][u]New Features:[/u][/b]
- Added a new "Sandbox" mode (in addition to normal, hard, and impossible)
- Sandbox mode gives the player infinite hunger and infinite days
- Sandbox mode works in the Dinner Party as well, except there is still only 1 day
- You cannot earn score, unlock badges, purchase scraps, or complete challenges in Sandbox mode
- Added hired hitmen to the main game who will search for the detective
- The chance for a hitman to appear increases as clues, suspects, and days are accumulated
- Killing hitmen will not anger any factions and will prevent any more for a while
- Added unique screen overlays for each costume pair
[b][u]Gameplay Changes:[/u][/b]
- Camera shifted slightly so the player is more centric
- Each hitman eliminated will provide a significant score boost
- Hitmen will show up much sooner and much more often on Hard and Impossible modes
- NPCs may warn the player when a hitman is currently searching for them
- Slowed hostile NPC's initial shooting times slightly on all modes
- Slower shooting only affects the first shot, so players can load in and react better
[b][u]Fixes and Improvements:[/u][/b]
- The 'Costumes' menu now gives tips depending on how many scraps you currently own
- Replaced "Challenge Points" with "Hitmen Killed" in the 'Statistics' menu
- Challenge Points can still be viewed within the Notebook
- Minor AI improvements
- Minor bug fixes

notes.title: Version 1.5 Now Available
notes.notes:
Noir Syndrome Version 1.5 is now available for all users!

As I had stated in the preview: if you've already played the game before the update, I recommend clicking 'Tutorial' and checking out the backstory. As for the Hunt Club, besides just being a new area to investigate, there are some mysterious happenings there. They don't just let anyone in on their secrets though - you'll have to figure that part out yourself.

If you missed the patch notes, take a quick look below to see what's new!

[b][u]New Features:[/u][/b]
- Added an Anubis intro story for new players (also shows up if you click 'Tutorial')
- New location added: The "Hunt Club"
- New optional subquests can be taken at The Hunt Club - if you can get in
- The UI will automatically hide itself if the mouse isn't used for a few seconds
[b][u]Gameplay Changes:[/u][/b]
- Hunger now displays as an exact number in the notebook for more precision
- Civilian/Police/Mob ID clues have been removed and replaced with a new key item
- Current bounties will display on Notebook page 4 with the challenges
- Added new hobby clues and combinations
- Added new first names for both men and women
- Tutorial slightly clarified
- Black market information cost reduced ($75->$50)
- Bullet prices slightly increased
[b][u]Fixes and Improvements:[/u][/b]
- Fixed incorrect evidence sometimes showing up
- The cursor will no longer be locked to the game screen in windowed mode
- Activated merchants will return to "not-selling" state if left alone for a few seconds
- Added an auditory cue when a challenge is completed
- Added advanced error logging
- AI improvements
- Minor bug fixes

notes.title: Version 1.4 Now Available
notes.notes:
Noir Syndrome Version 1.4 is now available for all users!

With the new difficulty changes, skilled players will be able to achieve higher scores than ever before - but it certainly won't be easy. Post screenshots of your high scores and stats to the community group, we'd love to see them! Of course there's lots more for everyone to enjoy, not just the ace detectives. Don't forget to check the new Notebook page for a different challenge each game! 

For those who missed the preview a couple days ago, check out the complete patch notes below.

[u][b]New Features:[/b][/u]
- Added Challenges to the notebook
- The player will receive one optional challenge per game
- Completing challenges will increase cash and costume scrap find bonuses permanently
- +1 scrap find per challenge point, +1 cash find per two challenge points
- Scrap find bonuses also apply to purchasing scraps
- Cash find bonuses also apply to looting safes and vaults
- Challenges reward double/triple points on hard/impossible modes
- Added new "Bullet Cam" that tracks the player's bullets so their flight and destination can be seen
- Players can still move between shots, only the vision has changed
- Added 2 new unlockable costumes
[u][b]Gameplay Changes:[/b][/u]
- Cost of items greatly increased on Hard and Impossible modes (175/250% -> 250/400%)
- Score bonus greatly improved on Hard and Impossible modes (200/300% -> 300/500%)
- NPCs will retaliate faster on harder difficulties
- NPCs will mention possible suspects more often
- Most food values slightly increased
- Some prices slightly increased
[u][b]Fixes and Improvements:[/b][/u]
- Added button to deselect culprits within the culprit selection screen
- Added notification icon over the notebook when it is updated
- Updated Stats page to include Challenge Points and Impossible Mode Wins
- Added gender icons for each name in the notebook and the culprit selection screen
- Minor difficulty tweaks
- AI improvements
- Minor bug fixes

notes.title: Version 1.4 Now Available
notes.notes:
Noir Syndrome Version 1.4 is now available for all users!

With the new difficulty changes, skilled players will be able to achieve higher scores than ever before - but it certainly won't be easy. Post screenshots of your high scores and stats to the community group, we'd love to see them! Of course there's lots more for everyone to enjoy, not just the ace detectives. Don't forget to check the new Notebook page for a different challenge each game! 

For those who missed the preview a couple days ago, check out the complete patch notes below.

[u][b]New Features:[/b][/u]
- Added Challenges to the notebook
- The player will receive one optional challenge per game
- Completing challenges will increase cash and costume scrap find bonuses permanently
- +1 scrap find per challenge point, +1 cash find per two challenge points
- Scrap find bonuses also apply to purchasing scraps
- Cash find bonuses also apply to looting safes and vaults
- Challenges reward double/triple points on hard/impossible modes
- Added new "Bullet Cam" that tracks the player's bullets so their flight and destination can be seen
- Players can still move between shots, only the vision has changed
- Added 2 new unlockable costumes
[u][b]Gameplay Changes:[/b][/u]
- Cost of items greatly increased on Hard and Impossible modes (175/250% -> 250/400%)
- Score bonus greatly improved on Hard and Impossible modes (200/300% -> 300/500%)
- NPCs will retaliate faster on harder difficulties
- NPCs will mention possible suspects more often
- Most food values slightly increased
- Some prices slightly increased
[u][b]Fixes and Improvements:[/b][/u]
- Added button to deselect culprits within the culprit selection screen
- Added notification icon over the notebook when it is updated
- Updated Stats page to include Challenge Points and Impossible Mode Wins
- Added gender icons for each name in the notebook and the culprit selection screen
- Minor difficulty tweaks
- AI improvements
- Minor bug fixes

notes.title: Version 1.3 Preview
notes.notes:
The Steam release of Noir Syndrome will include the brand new Version 1.3. Users on all platforms will be able to update their game and take advantage of the new features. Below is a summary of everything added or changed in Version 1.3.

[u][b]New Features:[/b][/u]
- Costume shop added to the main game, where players can purchase costume scraps bags
- Detective level and difficulty increase the scraps purchased
- Random costume scraps can still only be found in dinner party mode
- 2 new unlockable costumes added
- NPCs can now suggest 'Fishy' locations - these areas have extra items
- Added finer volume controls in the options menu (scale of 0-10)
[u][b]Gameplay Changes:[/b][/u]
- To balance the new 'Fishy' events, regular areas have slightly fewer items
- Crime scenes have more items then any other event
- Hard and Impossible modes give more costume scraps
- Slightly more costume scraps drop in dinner party mode
- Added lockpicking and looting to the tutorial
- Starting bullets reduced by 1 in the main game
[u][b]Fixes and Improvements:[/b][/u]
- Re-colored some UI text in Dinner Party mode
- Costume scraps now properly drop more often after detective levels 5 and 10
- Normal difficulty text re-colored to be more readable
- Some clues slightly clarified
- AI improvements - updated dialogue, less blocking stairs, faster reactions, and more
- Minor bug fixes
